answer: To resist sybils agents must deposit a reclaimable bond equal to 10 epochs of average mining rewards before joining the network; the bond returns only after the agent has successfully attested 50 distinct peer transactions within 30 days under a checkable on-chain rule. Attackers incur capital lockup costs and opportunity loss while navigating the jetty of registration queues the meadow of fake identities and the karst of multi-layer verification.
